name: JHEMCU JHE42B · standard
description: Detailed visible exterior with PCB, side-outlet buzzer, LED, socket, switch, battery and translucent wrapping; one complete supplied finder.

catalog.sourceName: JHEMCU standard JHE42B product page and seven manufacturer photographs; user front photograph

geometryEvidence.summary: Detailed photo-based exterior reconstruction constrained to the nominal 23 × 17 × 17 mm manufacturer web-page envelope; individual visible feature dimensions are estimated.
geometryEvidence.limitations: The official dimension photograph states 25 × 17 × 17 mm, conflicting with the web-page 23 × 17 × 17 mm text. The library retains the existing 23 mm nominal basis; actual length remains unresolved. No manufacturer CAD or dimensioned subfeature drawing was found. PCB, battery, buzzer side outlet, LED, socket, side-actuated cancel switch, leads and shrink-wrap positions/profiles are photographic estimates, not installation-certified dimensions. Hidden electronic and acoustic internals are omitted. No mounting holes are documented. Loose cable and installation hardware are excluded.

attributeConditions.bodyHeight: Manufacturer page and size photograph both state 17 mm overall, including battery and wrapping; subfeature heights remain estimates.

specifications.value: Keep the cancel button accessible; the manufacturer specifies a hold longer than two seconds.

specifications.label: Battery
specifications.value: Integral rechargeable backup battery; chemistry, capacity and detailed dimensions unverified.

specifications.label: Visible exterior
specifications.value: Closed buzzer top with a negative-X rectangular side sound outlet; white/yellow LED; separate positive-X socket and side-actuated cancel switch; silver pouch below PCB; translucent wrapper.

specifications.label: Dimensional fidelity
specifications.value: The detailed appearance follows manufacturer photos and the user front photograph. Numeric subfeature sizes and positions are estimates; this is not manufacturer CAD, a PCB fabrication file or a verified mounting drawing.

geometryEvidence.summary: One native 26 × 17 × 15 mm occupied box reproduces the latest project reference.
geometryEvidence.limitations: The latest platform source explicitly assigns JHE42B to a user-given 26 × 17 × 15 mm occupied box. This conflicts with the standard JHE42B's nominal 23 × 17 × 17 mm web-page basis, which remains a separate selection. Source component 234 still carries a stale JHE20B PartNumber; the current script, label and registry explicitly select JHE42B. This reference does not establish another supplier execution, product code, internal battery, speaker, socket, button, LED, mounting surface or cable geometry. Feature orientation and retention remain unverified. See lib/project-source-provenance.json for immutable source hashes and the conflict record.
